SELECT id, organization_id AS organizationId, code, name, DATE_FORMAT(starts_on, '%Y-%m-%d') AS startsOn, DATE_FORMAT(ends_on, '%Y-%m-%d') AS endsOn, is_current AS `current` FROM edu_term
AND (name LIKE concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR code LIKE concat('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY is_current DESC, starts_on DESC

SELECT id, organization_id AS organizationId, code, name, DATE_FORMAT(starts_on, '%Y-%m-%d') AS startsOn, DATE_FORMAT(ends_on, '%Y-%m-%d') AS endsOn, is_current AS `current` FROM edu_term WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE edu_term SET is_current = 0 WHERE is_current = 1
UPDATE edu_term SET is_current = 1 WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.sql: tc.id, tc.code, tc.name, tc.organization_id AS organizationId, tc.term_id AS termId, tc.term_id AS semesterId, t.name AS semesterName, t.name AS termName, tc.official_course_id AS officialCourseId, tc.official_course_id AS courseId, oc.name AS courseName, tc.class_kind AS classKind, tc.status, tc.status AS classStatus, DATE_FORMAT(tc.updated_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS updatedAt, (SELECT u.nick_name FROM edu_class_teacher ct JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = ct.user_id WHERE ct.teaching_class_id = tc.id AND ct.valid_to IS NULL ORDER BY (ct.teacher_role = 'LEAD') DESC, ct.id LIMIT 1) AS teacherName, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM edu_class_student cs WHERE cs.teaching_class_id = tc.id AND cs.left_at IS NULL) AS studentCount
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM edu_teaching_class tc LEFT JOIN edu_term t ON t.id = tc.term_id LEFT JOIN edu_official_course oc ON oc.id = tc.official_course_id
AND (tc.name LIKE concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR tc.code LIKE concat('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND tc.term_id = #{termId} AND tc.status = #{status}
ORDER BY tc.id DESC
SELECT FROM edu_teaching_class tc LEFT JOIN edu_term t ON t.id = tc.term_id LEFT JOIN edu_official_course oc ON oc.id = tc.official_course_id WHERE tc.id = #{id}

SELECT FROM edu_teaching_class tc INNER JOIN edu_class_teacher ct ON ct.teaching_class_id = tc.id LEFT JOIN edu_term t ON t.id = tc.term_id LEFT JOIN edu_official_course oc ON oc.id = tc.official_course_id WHERE ct.user_id = #{userId} AND ct.valid_to IS NULL ORDER BY tc.id DESC

SELECT cs.id AS memberId, cs.teaching_class_id AS classId, cs.user_id AS studentId, cs.user_id AS userId, u.user_name AS studentNo, u.user_name AS userName, u.nick_name AS studentName, u.nick_name AS nickName, IF(cs.left_at IS NULL, 'ACTIVE', 'LEFT') AS status, DATE_FORMAT(cs.joined_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS joinedAt, DATE_FORMAT(cs.left_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS leftAt FROM edu_class_student cs JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = cs.user_id WHERE cs.teaching_class_id = #{classId} ORDER BY (cs.left_at IS NULL) DESC, cs.id

SELECT ct.teaching_class_id AS classId, ct.user_id AS userId, u.user_name AS userName, u.nick_name AS nickName, ct.teacher_role AS teacherRole, ct.can_publish AS canPublish, ct.can_grade AS canGrade, ct.can_export AS canExport, DATE_FORMAT(ct.valid_from, '%Y-%m-%d') AS validFrom, DATE_FORMAT(ct.valid_to, '%Y-%m-%d') AS validTo FROM edu_class_teacher ct JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = ct.user_id WHERE ct.teaching_class_id = #{classId} ORDER BY (ct.valid_to IS NULL) DESC, ct.id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM edu_class_teacher WHERE teaching_class_id = #{classId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND valid_to IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO edu_class_student(teaching_class_id, user_id, joined_at, recorded_by_user_id) VALUES (#{classId}, #{userId}, NOW(3), #{recordedBy})

INSERT INTO edu_class_teacher(teaching_class_id, user_id, teacher_role, can_publish, can_grade, can_export, valid_from, valid_to, granted_by_user_id) VALUES (#{classId}, #{userId}, #{teacherRole}, IFNULL(#{canPublish}, 0), IFNULL(#{canGrade}, 0), IFNULL(#{canExport}, 0), NOW(3),
STR_TO_DATE(#{validTo}, '%Y-%m-%d') NULL , #{grantedBy})
mapper.select:
SELECT u.user_id AS userId, u.user_name AS userName, u.nick_name AS nickName, d.dept_name AS deptName, u.phonenumber AS phone, u.phonenumber AS phonenumber, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM edu_class_teacher ct WHERE ct.user_id = u.user_id AND ct.valid_to IS NULL) AS classCount FROM sys_user u JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.user_id = u.user_id JOIN sys_role r ON r.role_id = ur.role_id AND r.role_key = 'teacher' AND r.status = '0' LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON d.dept_id = u.dept_id WHERE u.del_flag = '0' AND u.status = '0'
AND (u.user_name LIKE concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.nick_name LIKE concat('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND (u.dept_id = #{deptId} OR FIND_IN_SET(#{deptId}, d.ancestors))
ORDER BY u.user_id

SELECT ct.teaching_class_id AS classId, tc.name AS className, tc.name AS name, t.name AS termName, t.name AS semesterName, ct.teacher_role AS teacherRole, ct.can_publish AS canPublish, ct.can_grade AS canGrade, ct.can_export AS canExport, DATE_FORMAT(ct.valid_from, '%Y-%m-%d') AS validFrom, DATE_FORMAT(ct.valid_to, '%Y-%m-%d') AS validTo, tc.status FROM edu_class_teacher ct JOIN edu_teaching_class tc ON tc.id = ct.teaching_class_id LEFT JOIN edu_term t ON t.id = tc.term_id WHERE ct.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY (ct.valid_to IS NULL) DESC, ct.id DESC

SELECT u.user_id AS userId, u.user_name AS userName, u.nick_name AS nickName, d.dept_name AS deptName, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(tc.name ORDER BY tc.id SEPARATOR '、') FROM edu_class_student cs JOIN edu_teaching_class tc ON tc.id = cs.teaching_class_id WHERE cs.user_id = u.user_id AND cs.left_at IS NULL) AS className, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM edu_class_student cs WHERE cs.user_id = u.user_id AND cs.left_at IS NULL) AS classCount FROM sys_user u JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.user_id = u.user_id JOIN sys_role r ON r.role_id = ur.role_id AND r.role_key = 'student' AND r.status = '0' LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON d.dept_id = u.dept_id WHERE u.del_flag = '0' AND u.status = '0'
AND (u.user_name LIKE concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.nick_name LIKE concat('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY u.user_id

SELECT cs.teaching_class_id AS classId, tc.name AS className, tc.name AS name, tc.code AS code, tc.organization_id AS organizationId, tc.term_id AS termId, tc.class_kind AS classKind, tc.status AS classStatus, t.name AS termName, t.name AS semesterName, IF(cs.left_at IS NULL, 'ACTIVE', 'LEFT') AS status, DATE_FORMAT(cs.joined_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS joinedAt, DATE_FORMAT(cs.left_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS leftAt FROM edu_class_student cs JOIN edu_teaching_class tc ON tc.id = cs.teaching_class_id LEFT JOIN edu_term t ON t.id = tc.term_id WHERE cs.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY (cs.left_at IS NULL) DESC, cs.id DESC

SELECT d.dept_id AS id, d.dept_name AS name, d.parent_id AS parentId, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_user u JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.user_id = u.user_id JOIN sys_role r ON r.role_id = ur.role_id AND r.role_key = 'teacher' WHERE u.dept_id = d.dept_id AND u.del_flag = '0') AS teacherCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_user u JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.user_id = u.user_id JOIN sys_role r ON r.role_id = ur.role_id AND r.role_key = 'student' WHERE u.dept_id = d.dept_id AND u.del_flag = '0') AS studentCount FROM sys_dept d WHERE d.del_flag = '0' AND d.status = '0' ORDER BY d.parent_id, d.order_num, d.dept_id

SELECT id, code, name, status FROM edu_official_course
AND (name LIKE concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR code LIKE concat('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY code
mapper.sql: cs.id, cs.title AS name, cs.title, cs.status, cs.summary, cs.learning_objectives AS learningObjectives, cs.official_course_id AS officialCourseId, cs.owner_user_id AS ownerUserId, oc.name AS officialCourseName, u.nick_name AS teacherName, DATE_FORMAT(cs.updated_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS updatedAt, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(tc.name ORDER BY tc.id SEPARATOR '、') FROM edu_course_class_binding b JOIN edu_teaching_class tc ON tc.id = b.teaching_class_id WHERE b.course_space_id = cs.id AND b.ended_at IS NULL) AS className, (SELECT t.name FROM edu_course_class_binding b JOIN edu_teaching_class tc ON tc.id = b.teaching_class_id JOIN edu_term t ON t.id = tc.term_id WHERE b.course_space_id = cs.id AND b.ended_at IS NULL ORDER BY b.id LIMIT 1) AS semesterName, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM edu_course_class_binding b WHERE b.course_space_id = cs.id AND b.ended_at IS NULL) AS classCount, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cst.user_id) FROM edu_course_class_binding b JOIN edu_class_student cst ON cst.teaching_class_id = b.teaching_class_id AND cst.left_at IS NULL WHERE b.course_space_id = cs.id AND b.ended_at IS NULL) AS studentCount
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM edu_course_space cs LEFT JOIN edu_official_course oc ON oc.id = cs.official_course_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = cs.owner_user_id
AND cs.owner_user_id = #{ownerUserId}
AND cs.status = 'ACTIVE' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM edu_course_class_binding b JOIN edu_class_student cst ON cst.teaching_class_id = b.teaching_class_id WHERE b.course_space_id = cs.id AND b.ended_at IS NULL AND cst.user_id = #{studentUserId} AND cst.left_at IS NULL)
AND cs.title LIKE concat('%', #{keyword}, '%')
ORDER BY cs.updated_at DESC, cs.id DESC
SELECT FROM edu_course_space cs LEFT JOIN edu_official_course oc ON oc.id = cs.official_course_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = cs.owner_user_id WHERE cs.id = #{id}
SELECT id, parent_unit_id AS parentUnitId, unit_kind AS unitKind, title, sort_order AS sortOrder FROM edu_course_unit WHERE course_space_id = #{courseId} ORDER BY sort_order, id
SELECT id, unit_id AS unitId, code, name FROM edu_knowledge_point WHERE course_space_id = #{courseId} ORDER BY code, id

SELECT b.id, b.teaching_class_id AS classId, tc.name AS name, tc.name AS className, t.name AS termName, DATE_FORMAT(b.published_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS publishedAt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM edu_class_student cst WHERE cst.teaching_class_id = b.teaching_class_id AND cst.left_at IS NULL) AS studentCount FROM edu_course_class_binding b JOIN edu_teaching_class tc ON tc.id = b.teaching_class_id LEFT JOIN edu_term t ON t.id = tc.term_id WHERE b.course_space_id = #{courseId} AND b.ended_at IS NULL ORDER BY b.id

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cst.user_id) FROM edu_course_class_binding b JOIN edu_class_student cst ON cst.teaching_class_id = b.teaching_class_id WHERE b.course_space_id = #{courseId} AND b.ended_at IS NULL AND cst.user_id = #{userId} AND cst.left_at IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM edu_course_class_binding WHERE course_space_id = #{courseId} AND teaching_class_id = #{classId} AND ended_at IS NULL

UPDATE edu_course_space SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id} AND owner_user_id = #{ownerUserId}
